covers: Wall Street's first 40 minutes on Friday 6 November 2026 (US prices to 17:09 SAST), the JSE to 16:49 SAST, and US company results filed on 5–6 November
headline: Wall Street rebounds at the open after the jobs report — Nasdaq +1.5%, S&P 500 +0.8% — while IREN (scanner STRONG SELL) jumps 17.9% on results
summary: Late in the JSE session the All Share was at 112,925 and the Top 40 at 104,868 (16:49 SAST), 4.9% and 5.5% up on a week ago, with Sappi still down 14.7% at R11.11 on its results day. In New York the S&P 500 was at 7,411.51 (+0.8% on Thursday's 7,353.73) and the Nasdaq Composite at 24,670.97 (+1.5%) at 17:09 SAST, though both remain 2.2% and 3.0% below a week ago; the US 10-year yield was 4.89% after October payrolls rose 165,000. The rand firmed to R16.52/$ (R16.58 at 16:19), gold was $4,058 (+4.1% on the week) and Brent $97.64 (−17.0% on the week) (LRC Market Dashboard, 6 Nov 2026).

items.title: IREN +17.9% to $21.27 after quarterly revenue rose 66% to $228m
items.summary: IREN (LRC Stock Scanner: STRONG SELL, target $9.02 — unchanged by this desk) traded at $21.27 at 17:09 SAST, up 17.9% from Thursday's $18.03 close. For the quarter to 30 September 2026 it reported revenue of $228m (June quarter: $137m), AI Cloud revenue of $200m (+182% on the quarter) and Bitcoin mining revenue of $28m (from $67m). The net loss narrowed to $263m from $684m. Revenue backlog rose 22% on the quarter to $20.3bn, about two-thirds with investment-grade counterparties, and the company says its more-than-$4bn annual run-rate target is fully contracted and funded. The share is now more than double the scanner target, so the gap between price and target has widened.
items.source: IREN Q1 FY27 results, SEC Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1, filed 5 Nov 2026; LRC Stock Scanner (Yahoo Finance prices), 5 Nov close and 6 Nov 2026 17:09 SAST

items.title: Tech leads the open: S&P 500 7,411.51 (+0.8%), Nasdaq 24,670.97 (+1.5%)
items.summary: At 17:09 SAST, against Thursday's closes of 7,353.73 and 24,315.00. On the week the S&P 500 is still 2.2% lower (30 Oct: 7,580.07) and the Nasdaq 3.0% lower (25,437.00). Nvidia was up 5.6% at $191.72. The US 10-year Treasury yield was 4.89%, from 4.87% at 16:19 and 4.84% at Thursday's close, after the October jobs report (+165,000 payrolls, unemployment 4.1%; BLS, 6 Nov).
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance prices), 6 Nov 2026 17:09 SAST; LRC Stock Scanner, 6 Nov 2026 17:09 SAST; US Bureau of Labor Statistics, 6 Nov 2026

items.title: Results movers: Cloudflare +11.9%, Airbnb +8.9%, Moderna +7.3%
items.summary: Cloudflare (scanner HOLD) reported Q3 revenue of $782.5m, up 39% on a year earlier. Airbnb (HOLD) reported Q3 revenue of $4.9bn (+19%) and net income of $1.9bn, guided Q4 revenue to $3.22–3.28bn and added a $12bn share buyback authorisation. Moderna (HOLD) reported Q3 revenue of $1.3bn and raised its 2026 revenue-growth outlook to 15–25% from up to 10%. Prices at 17:09 SAST: Cloudflare $273.62, Airbnb $185.33 (above the scanner's $121.70 target), Moderna $258.98 (above its $125.00 target).
items.source: Company results, SEC Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1: Cloudflare and Airbnb filed 5 Nov 2026, Moderna 6 Nov 2026; LRC Stock Scanner (Yahoo Finance prices), 6 Nov 2026 17:09 SAST
